name: Bold Flat Colour
blurb: Fat red shapes on emerald, yellow type stacked tight, a Seoul canteen poster.
medium: A vector illustration built from a few huge flat shapes in saturated inks, printed as a poster with perfect hard edges and tiny cut out details in cream. It looks like a designer drew it in a vector tool and sent it to a good printer.

palette.note: One saturated ground, one dominant hero colour and one loud type colour, plus small pink and blue accents. For a brand, set the ground to their main colour and make the hero and type the two most contrasting colours available.

composition: Two or three oversized objects tilt diagonally across the page and run off the edges, leaving the type to sit across them in a stack. A few small round or bowl shapes scatter in the gaps. The bottom corner stays quiet for small info in a darker tint of the ground.
typography: Extra heavy blocky sans or grotesk in a single bright colour, stacked in two to three tight lines and allowed to overlap the illustration. Small info text in a darker tint of the background.
texture: Perfectly flat colour with a barely visible paper grain, no gradients, no shadows.
signature: objects cropped by the edges at diagonals
tiny scale patterns cut into the hero shapes
ground colour reused for small info text

example.subject: Late night noodle shop opening in Malmö
example.headline: Slurp Season
example.subline: Hand pulled noodles until 2 am

sampleBrief: A vertical 2:3 poster in bold flat colour vector illustration, for a late night noodle shop. Three giant red noodle bowls seen from above are drawn as flat circles with cream chopsticks, swirled noodle lines in cream and small cut out details, each tilted on a diagonal and cropped by the page edges. Between them sit a few magenta dots and a pink and blue bowl shape as punctuation. The ground is a solid emerald green. Palette: emerald #0E8A5A, red #FF1B1B, yellow #FFE800, magenta #F0359A, pink #F7B4D0, blue #1B4FC4. All shapes are perfectly flat with hard edges, no outlines, no gradients, no shadows. Typography spelled exactly: the headline "SLURP SEASON" in extra heavy blocky yellow capitals, stacked on two tight lines in the upper left and overlapping the top of the bowls; the line "Hand pulled noodles until 2 am" in small clean sans beneath it; and at the bottom edge in a darker green tint, small text "Open Thu to Sun, Möllevången 12". Lighting: none, only flat colour. Texture: the faintest paper grain, crisp as a good offset print. Composition leaves the lower left quiet. Avoid gradients, drop shadows, stock icon style, plastic 3D sheen, lens flare, symmetrical stock composition, thin timid type, gibberish or extra text.

name: Halftone Duotone
blurb: A photographed face or animal in two clashing inks, giant type biting into it.
medium: A photograph converted to a coarse halftone duotone, printed in two fluorescent inks on uncoated paper, with giant condensed type that overprints and multiplies against the picture. It looks like a riso or screen print, not a filter.

palette.note: Choose two high chroma inks that clash on purpose, such as blue and red or pink and lime. For a brand, take the main and accent colours as the two inks and set paper to a warm neutral.

composition: The photographic subject is cropped tight and large, centred or slightly off, with two or three lines of massive type running across the face and body, left aligned. A small paragraph of text sits in the top right corner and tiny credits in the corners.
typography: Heavy condensed or bold grotesk capitals in the second ink, giant, multiplying over the image, with small justified text paragraph in the same ink.
texture: Visible halftone dot screen, ink overlap colour, grain, slight blur from the press.
signature: text block top right in the second ink

example.subject: Monthly night run club for beginners
example.headline: Run Slow
example.subline: Friendly 5 km night loops with tea after

sampleBrief: A vertical 2:3 halftone duotone poster, printed in two clashing inks on uncoated paper, for a beginners' night running club. A close crop of a runner in glasses and a knit hat, face turned slightly and calm, rendered as a coarse visible halftone dot screen in electric blue ink, with the hat and shoulders filling the lower two thirds. Giant heavy condensed capitals in fluorescent red overprint the face and torso in two stacked lines, multiplying into deep purple where they cross the blue. A small justified text paragraph sits in the top right in red, and tiny credits sit in the corners. Palette: cream paper #F4EFE2, blue ink #3B49E8, red ink #FF4B3F, overlap deep purple. Typography spelled exactly: headline "RUN SLOW" in giant condensed capitals in red; the paragraph at top right reads "Friendly 5 km night loops with tea after"; at the bottom in tiny red capitals "First Thursday each month, 19:00, Rålambshovsparken". Lighting: none, ink only. Texture: halftone dots, press grain, slight blur and misregistration between inks, speckled coverage. Avoid full colour photography, smooth gradients, drop shadows, glossy finish, lens flare, symmetrical stock composition, extra or gibberish text.

name: Pixel World
blurb: Voxel flowers, dither clouds and chunky dot type float in a cut paper sky.
medium: A pixel art and voxel illustration: chunky cubes with flat three tone shading, dither patterns and dot matrix lettering, composed over a calm sky photograph or flat blue field. It has the precision of game art and the calm of a poster.

palette.note: Sky blue ground with pink, green and cream voxels and one orange spark. For a brand, set the sky or field to the brand colour and the voxel hero to its complement.

composition: One hero object, a flower or creature, rises from the lower centre in cubes with floating satellite pieces and tiny sparks, dot matrix title at the top, small body text lower corners. Lots of empty sky around.
typography: Dot matrix or pixel capitals in lime or white for the title, small serif or mono lines for details.
texture: Hard pixel edges, flat three tone shading per cube, dither gradients, no blur.
signature: voxel object with 3 tone cube shading
dot matrix title made of circles

refs.author: Kamilla Z. | Captain of Visual Chaos

name: Grain Shape Animals
blurb: Blocky animals built from clean shapes, sprayed with soft grain on warm yellow.
medium: A digital and gouache illustration where an animal is assembled from bold geometric slabs, each filled with a soft speckled airbrush gradient that fades two colours together. The grain looks like sprayed ink on paper.

palette.note: Mustard yellow ground with primary red, blue and green shapes and one pink accent. Brand adaptation: keep the warm ground and recolour the shapes in the brand pair, letting grain fade each into the other.

composition: One large animal leans diagonally across most of the page, with small companions like a bird or clouds in the open yellow. A row of tiny houses or hills can run along the bottom. Text sits in the clear lower right and along the vertical edge.
typography: Clean geometric sans in mixed colours, set at an angle that follows the animal, with colour changes between lines. Small vertical credit text in the margin.
texture: Spray grain stipple inside each shape, edges crisp, flat colour elsewhere.
signature: animal made of slabs and wedges
grain gradient between two colours per shape
tiny house row at the bottom

name: Brush Marker Lettering
blurb: Fat pink letters painted with a loaded brush, outlined in electric blue.
medium: Hand painted lettering in gouache or acrylic with a flat brush on white paper, scanned, with letters filled in fluorescent pink, a heavy blue outline, a few yellow rays and wet edges where the brush dragged.

palette.note: White ground with hot pink fill, electric blue outline and a lime accent. For a brand, fill letters in the brand brightest colour and outline in its darkest, keep one acid accent.

composition: Phrase words fill the whole sheet in stacked rows of different sizes, tilted, touching the edges, with a handwritten script signature line at the bottom. A tiny line of print info sits in the bottom margin.
typography: Chunky uneven capitals, painted and not set, with a loopy script sign off. Info line in small neutral sans.
texture: Brush streaks, uneven opacity, dry brush edges, paper tooth and paint bumps.

tilted stacked words filling the sheet

name: Riso Market Scene

typography: Chunky hand cut capitals each letter in a different ink, stacked in three lines, and a small wide spaced caps line for info.
texture: Visible riso grain, ink overprints, tiny gaps between inks, paper texture.

name: Blob Gradient Pop
blurb: Soft fluid blobs in blue, pink and orange swirl behind rounded letters.
medium: A digital gradient illustration of fluid, melted blob shapes with glowing inner light, edge noise and a thin outer stroke, composed on a flat saturated field. It feels like an airbrushed risograph.

palette.note: A saturated field with two glowing blob colours and one pale highlight. For a brand, put the brand colour in the field and let the blobs be two adjacent shades.

composition: A big cluster of blobs fills the middle two thirds, overlapping, with smaller blobs breaking free. The title overprints the cluster, line up information goes at the bottom edge in small caps on the flat field.
typography: Rounded or bubbly heavy letters in white or pale pink, large, overlapping the blobs, and tiny clean caps for details.
texture: Soft internal glow, subtle noise grain at the edges, smooth gradients.

name: Sliced Portrait Cover
blurb: A studio face cut into shifting strips under a refined serif masthead.
medium: A photographic cover where a studio portrait is physically or digitally manipulated: concentric cuts, strips, torn paper or huge type masking parts of the face. The manipulation looks like cut paper or a layered print, not a filter.

palette.note: Mostly neutral photo tones with black type and one red accent. For a brand, use the brand colour for the single accent and the masthead.

composition: Masthead across the top in a big serif or grotesk, the face occupying the whole sheet with a visible cut pattern in the middle, one or two cover lines lower left or right in small type, and a small red issue number. The rest of the face is left untouched so the cut reads clearly.
typography: Large refined serif masthead, and small tidy sans cover lines in black, with a single red numeral.
texture: Fine photographic grain, cut paper edges with soft shadow, slight paper creases.
signature: masthead partly covered by the head

name: Pop Cutout Collage
blurb: A hard cut figure on a red starburst, with tape, tulips and bright paper.
medium: A bright mixed media collage of hard cut photographs, coloured paper shapes, scribbled vector doodles and tape, assembled digitally to look like cut paper. Photos are slightly desaturated and the paper is saturated.

typography: Bold blocky grotesk in cream or black on cut paper strips, plus hand scribbled marker words in neon lines.
texture: Paper fibre, torn tape, subtle shadows, small halftone speckle on photos.

name: Psychedelic Lettering

texture: Screen print ink with slight overprint darkening, paper grain, halftone dots in the photo.

Lighting: studio key with strong rim light, real skin texture and muscle definition, slight film grain on the ground. Avoid airbrushed skin, plastic 3D sheen, lens flare, clip art silhouettes, symmetrical stock composition, extra or gibberish text.

name: Liquid Chrome Type
blurb: Letters melted into mirror metal, blobby and bright, framed by a thin HUD border.
medium: A 3D rendered liquid metal lettering: puffy, molten letterforms with mirror chrome material that reflects a pale sky studio, with pinched highlights, rendered on a soft pale ground with a thin interface frame around it.

palette.note: Silver and pale blue with warm pink reflections on a light ground. For a brand, tint the reflections in the brand colour and keep the metal neutral.

composition: The title fills the centre as one molten mass in two or three lines, with a thin rounded border frame, small circular icons and a barcode in the corners. Rest of the page is quiet pale gradient.
typography: The title itself is the artwork, in molten, puffed letters; small clean sans and mono for corners, plus a compass star ornament above.
texture: Mirror reflections with pinched highlights, subtle ground noise, crisp thin frame lines.

example.subject: Hair studio grand opening
example.headline: Silver Fox
example.subline: Colour, cuts and chrome nails

sampleBrief: A vertical 2:3 poster featuring molten liquid chrome lettering on a pale gradient ground, for a hair studio opening. The words "SILVER FOX" are rendered in puffy, molten, 3D mirror chrome letterforms stacked on two lines in the centre, fused into one mass with pinched highlights and soft pink reflections, reflecting a pale studio sky. Palette: pale ground #EAF1F6, steel blue #9FB6CC, blush reflection #D8C7C2, dark #2B3646, white #FFFFFF. A thin rounded border frame with notched corners surrounds the page, small circular and globe icons sit at the top corners, an eight point star ornament above the title, a QR code at the lower left and a barcode at the bottom centre. Typography spelled exactly: the molten chrome title "SILVER FOX"; beneath it in small clean sans "Colour, cuts and chrome nails"; at the bottom "Opening Sat 5 Apr, Odengatan 30" in tiny monospace. Lighting: bright soft studio dome light with crisp mirror reflections. Texture: fine subtle noise on the ground, crisp frame lines. Avoid flat grey metal, lens flare streaks, dark moody lighting, muddy brown reflections, glitter, symmetrical stock composition, extra or gibberish text.

name: Layered Papercut
blurb: Stacked paper layers form a glowing valley, lit from below like a tiny theatre.
medium: Real cut paper: five layers of coloured card cut with a craft knife, visible blade edges and small shadows between layers, bold simple shapes.

palette.note: Cool grey blue and dusty mauve layers with one warm sliver of light. For a brand, make the layers tints and shades of the brand colour, and keep the warm light low.

composition: A large curving wave of layers sweeps from the top left diagonally to a small figure or building at the bottom right. A pale near empty ground gives the title space in the top right and body text at the bottom.
typography: Light elegant serif headline in black or deep blue sitting on the pale ground, small tidy sans captions beneath, justified paragraph at the bottom left.
texture: Soft shadows between layers, subtle fibres, a little glow inside the valley.
signature: tiny scene at the end of the wave

example.subject: Winter cabin stays under the northern lights
example.headline: Under the Lights
example.subline: Cabins in Abisko, from December to March

sampleBrief: A poster made from real cut paper, portrait 2:3: five layers of matte coloured card (dusk blue #3E5A7A, moss #5E7A4E, ochre #C99A3E, rust #A8553A, cream #EFE6D4) cut with a craft knife into big simple rolling hill shapes that sweep diagonally from bottom left, small shadows between layers, the blade edges slightly irregular, one hill pierced with a row of punched holes as stars. A tiny cut paper cabin with a yellow window sits on the highest ridge. The top half is plain cream card with room for type: a large serif 'Under the Lights' and a small line 'Cabins in Abisko, from December to March'. Photographed flat with soft even light.

name: Cutout Plant Collage
blurb: Cut out real leaves beside tall serif letters, with one wild red leaf.
medium: A digital photo collage of cut out plant photographs layered on a white page with thin keylines and small text boxes, as an editorial designer would build in layout software. The photos are real studio shots, hard cut with clean edges.

palette.note: White ground, black type, natural leaf greens and one fiery red and orange leaf as the surprise. For a brand, make the type colour the brand dark and let a single plant accent echo the brand accent.

composition: Two or three huge leaves cross the page from one side, with a narrow vertical or rotated title running up the edge, a pinned grid of tiny text and a small hanging plant inset. White space is generous and leaves bleed off the edges.
typography: Elegant high contrast serif capitals, huge and rotated ninety degrees along an edge, with tiny sans body text in thin boxed columns.
texture: Clean studio shadows under leaves, subtle paper white, crisp keylines.
signature: rotated giant serif title along the edge
one saturated red leaf against green ones

example.subject: Pop up plant lending library in a cafe
example.headline: Leaf Library
example.subline: Borrow a houseplant for the season
example.details: Open Wed to Sun, Café Fikon, Sankt Eriksgatan 40

sampleBrief: A vertical 2:3 editorial photo collage poster on a clean white page, for a plant lending library pop up. Real studio photographs of houseplants cut out with crisp edges: a huge glossy green rubber plant leaf and a spiky monstera leaf cross the page from the lower left, a single fiery red and orange croton leaf enters from the upper right, and a small trailing string of pearls sits inside a thin hairline box near the top. Soft contact shadows beneath leaves on the white ground. Palette: white #FFFFFF, ink black #1C1C1C, leaf green #3E7A3C, lime #C8D86A, red #C0301F, amber #E8A02E. A narrow vertical title runs rotated ninety degrees up the left edge in huge elegant high contrast serif capitals reading "LEAF LIBRARY". A thin rule grid with tiny sans text boxes near the top: "Borrow a houseplant for the season". At the bottom in small clean sans: "Open Wed to Sun, Café Fikon, Sankt Eriksgatan 40". Lighting: soft studio daylight from above, gentle shadows. Texture: crisp hairlines, clean white, slight photographic sharpness. Avoid watercolour effects, clip art leaves, plastic sheen, lens flare, symmetrical stock composition, green on green clutter, gibberish or extra text.

name: Neon Tube Glow
blurb: Thin tubes of cold blue light trace logos on black, humming and slightly smeared.
medium: A glowing neon and LED display captured as a photograph of tubes and dot matrix lights on a black screen, with bloom, light haze and a faint reflection. Lines have constant thickness and rounded ends.

palette.note: Black with one cold neon colour in two intensities and a white hot core. For a brand, use the brand colour for the tubes and keep the white core.

composition: A cluster of tube logos and glyphs fills the middle, with generous black space, a small caption paragraph beneath, and numbers in a bottom row. A dot grid or scan lines optionally in the background.
typography: Monoline wide capitals made of tubes or LED dots, with tiny spaced caption text in pale blue below.
texture: Bloom and haze around bright lines, soft glow reflection, fine scan line texture.
signature: monoline tube letters with white hot core

example.subject: Retro arcade bar opening
example.headline: Neon Heron
example.subline: Pinball, cocktails and late night games

sampleBrief: A vertical 2:3 poster in a neon tube and LED display style, for a retro arcade bar opening. Pure black ground #02030A. In the middle a bird shaped heron glyph drawn as a monoline neon tube in electric blue #2D8CFF with a white hot core #F5FBFF and soft cold haze, above the name in wide monoline tube capitals. A secondary row of small LED dot matrix icons, a pinball, a joystick and a cocktail glass, sits beneath. A faint dot grid and fine scan lines in the background, light haze and a faint floor reflection. Palette: black, electric blue, pale blue #9FD4FF, white, deep blue #1A3FA0. Typography spelled exactly: headline "NEON HERON" in monoline tube capitals in the middle; beneath it in tiny spaced pale blue mono text "Pinball, cocktails and late night games"; at the bottom row "Opens Fri 3 Oct, Kungsgatan 27". Lighting: the glow is the only light source, bloom around the brightest lines. Texture: haze, bloom, faint scan lines. Avoid rainbow neon, lens flare streaks, brushed metal, chrome, clip art neon signs, symmetrical stock composition, extra or gibberish text.
